notes: You can now see exactly where your voice is going while you talk. When you key up, every net carrying your transmission lights an ON AIR badge with a blinking indicator and the whole channel card pulses amber — not just a subtle name tint that was easy to miss mid-op. Transmitting on several nets at once, or over a ship's 1MC, lights every net your voice reaches. If you have animations turned off in Windows for accessibility, the badge and border show steady instead of pulsing.
